description: Summary figure: MEC-14 closest relatives, tetrad geometry, ortholog conservation, cofactor site
code:
import os, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT=os.getcwd()
rank=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"identity_vs_mec14.csv"))
tg=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"tetrad_geometry_AF.csv"))
orthdf=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"ortholog_site_conservation.csv"))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(14,10))

# (a) identity ranking
ax=axes[0,0]
r=rank[rank.protein!="MEC14_Cel"].head(14).iloc[::-1]
cols=["#c43d3d" if "LGalDH" in p else ("#2a6fb5" if ("KCNAB" in p or "Hk" in p) else ("#888888" if "MEC14" in p else "#c9c9c9")) for p in r.protein]
ax.barh(r.protein, r.pct_id_vs_MEC14, color=cols)
ax.set_xlabel("% identity to MEC-14 over PF00248 domain")
ax.set_title("a  Closest relatives of MEC-14 in a 41-protein AKR panel")
ax.axvline(30,ls=":",c="k",lw=0.8)
for lab,c in [("L-galactose dehydrogenase","#c43d3d"),("Kvbeta / AKR6","#2a6fb5"),("MEC-14 orthologs","#888888")]:
    ax.scatter([],[],c=c,label=lab,s=60)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right")

# (b) tetrad geometry
ax=axes[0,1]
x=np.arange(len(tg)); w=0.27
for k,(col,lab) in enumerate([("Asp_Lys","Asp-Lys"),("Lys_Tyr","Lys-Tyr"),("Tyr_X4","Tyr-X4")]):
    ax.bar(x+(k-1)*w, tg[col], w, label=lab)
ax.axhline(3.5,ls="--",c="k",lw=0.9)
ax.text(len(tg)-0.5,3.65,"3.5 A H-bond limit",ha="right",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([m.replace(" AF","\n") for m in tg.model],fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("side-chain tip distance (A)")
ax.set_title("b  Catalytic tetrad H-bond network in AlphaFold models")
ax.legend(fontsize=8)

# (c) ortholog conservation
ax=axes[1,0]
cols=["D132 (=AKR Asp43)","Y137 (=AKR Tyr48)","K163 (=AKR Lys77)","Q204 (=AKR His110)","H206 (alt His)","D354","Q358"]
sub=orthdf.dropna(subset=["pct_id"]).sort_values("pct_id",ascending=False)
ref={"D132 (=AKR Asp43)":"D","Y137 (=AKR Tyr48)":"Y","K163 (=AKR Lys77)":"K",
     "Q204 (=AKR His110)":"Q","H206 (alt His)":"H","D354":"D","Q358":"Q"}
M=np.array([[1.0 if sub.iloc[i][c]==ref[c] else (np.nan if sub.iloc[i][c]=="-" else 0.0) for c in cols] for i in range(len(sub))])
ax.imshow(M,cmap="RdYlGn",vmin=0,vmax=1,aspect="auto")
ax.set_xticks(range(len(cols))); ax.set_xticklabels([c.split(" ")[0] for c in cols],rotation=0)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(sub))); ax.set_yticklabels([o[:28] for o in sub.org],fontsize=7)
for i in range(len(sub)):
    for k,c in enumerate(cols):
        ax.text(k,i,str(sub.iloc[i][c]),ha="center",va="center",fontsize=7)
ax.set_title("c  Active-site residues across 20 nematode MEC-14 orthologs")

# (d) 2'-phosphate site
ax=axes[1,1]; ax.axis("off")
t2=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"tetrad_and_2P_site.csv"))
tbl=t2[["protein","Asp43","Tyr48","Lys77","His110","2'-P site (K263,S264,V265,T266,R269)"]]
the=ax.table(cellText=tbl.values, colLabels=["protein","Asp43","Tyr48","Lys77","His110","NADPH 2'-phosphate site"],
             loc="center", cellLoc="center")
the.auto_set_font_size(False); the.set_fontsize(7); the.scale(1,1.35)
ax.set_title("d  Catalytic tetrad and 2'-phosphate site mapped from aldose reductase (AKR1B1)",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
